system.effect:
Trigger: You hit with a Damaging Telekinetic Move or use another Telekinetic Move
Effect: The effect of this Feature depends on the Triggering Move.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.dwKfen4bsSh3Q640]{Barrier}: Place 2 additional segments of Barrier, and you may place the Barriers anywhere within 6 meters of yourself. They do not need to remain contiguous, nor does one segment have to touch you.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.8SwtCsUUCbHbGWo6]{Kinesis}: The user of the triggering attack becomes @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.pLKjxFPUOZQHAcXH]{Confused} and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.uxkB2vhF5HGjQAZY]{Suppressed}.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.URD2vV0dvN5vhbsK]{Meditate}: You gain +1 Defense, Special Attack, and Special Defense Combat Stages.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.mw0PcwRSYEbxYyWs]{Psychic}: The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.wqzPWKMbwvOWLVoI]{Vulnerable} for one full round, and may be Pushed 2 additional meters.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.tNexDVIwrtPBsV0u]{Telekinesis}: At the end of each turn that the target remains Lifted, they lose a Tick of Hit Points.
- @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.Ad8f7gyjwE4CR0GJ]{Twin Beam}: You may use of Twin Beam again, ignoring Frequency, against the same or another target in range, although this use of Twin Beam lacks the "Double Strike" keyword.
system.name: Psionic Overload [CR]
